Lufkin sits at the heart of Deep East Texas, a piney-woods hub of roughly 34,500 people that anchors Angelina County and the smaller communities around it. The region's identity was built on timber, and that heritage still runs deep through local mills and wood products work, alongside a long history of oil and gas equipment manufacturing tied to names like Lufkin Industries.
